scenarios.description_en: A 5-minute daily standup in a Chinese automotive Android team. The team is working on CTS testing for a new IVI system.

lines.speaker: 项目经理
lines.chinese: 大家早上好，我们先看一下昨天的进展。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā zǎoshang hǎo, wǒmen xiān kàn yīxià zuótiān de jìnzhǎn.
lines.english: Good morning everyone, let's first look at yesterday's progress.

lines.speaker: 测试工程师
lines.chinese: 昨天我跑了CTS测试，发现三个新的失败用例，都是关于蓝牙的。
lines.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ pǎo le CTS cèshì, fāxiàn sān gè xīn de shībài yònglì, dōu shì guānyú lányá de.
lines.english: Yesterday I ran the CTS tests and found three new failing cases, all related to Bluetooth.

lines.speaker: 安卓开发
lines.chinese: 蓝牙的failures我看到了，应该是HAL层的问题，我正在定位。
lines.pinyin: Lányá de failures wǒ kàn dào le, yīnggāi shì HAL céng de wèntí, wǒ zhèngzài dìngwèi.
lines.english: I saw the Bluetooth failures, they should be HAL layer issues, I'm debugging now.

lines.speaker: 测试负责人
lines.chinese: 这些蓝牙问题会影响CTS认证吗？我们需要尽快修复。
lines.pinyin: Zhèxiē lányá wèntí huì yǐngxiǎng CTS rènzhèng ma? Wǒmen xūyào jǐnkuài xiūfù.
lines.english: Will these Bluetooth issues affect CTS certification? We need to fix them as soon as possible.

lines.speaker: 安卓开发
lines.chinese: 影响不大，但最好在本周内提交patch。另外，我昨天修复了WiFi的crash问题，今天可以验证。
lines.pinyin: Yǐngxiǎng bù dà, dàn zuìhǎo zài běn zhōu nèi tíjiāo patch. Lìngwài, wǒ zuótiān xiūfù le WiFi de crash wèntí, jīntiān kěyǐ yànzhèng.
lines.english: Not much impact, but it's best to submit a patch within this week. Also, I fixed the WiFi crash issue yesterday, can be verified today.

lines.speaker: 测试工程师
lines.chinese: 好的，我今天会重新跑WiFi相关的CTS用例，确认修复是否有效。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ jīntiān huì chóngxīn pǎo WiFi xiāngguān de CTS yònglì, quèrèn xiūfù shìfǒu yǒuxiào.
lines.english: Okay, I'll rerun the WiFi-related CTS test cases today to confirm the fix is effective.

lines.speaker: 项目经理
lines.chinese: 还有别的阻塞项吗？CTS的整体通过率现在是多少？
lines.pinyin: Hái yǒu bié de zǔsè xiàng ma? CTS de zhěngtǐ tōngguò lǜ xiànzài shì duōshǎo?
lines.english: Any other blockers? What's the overall CTS pass rate now?

lines.speaker: 测试负责人
lines.chinese: 目前通过率是92%，目标是95%，主要卡在蓝牙和多媒体模块。
lines.pinyin: Mùqián tōngguò lǜ shì 92%, mùbiāo shì 95%, zhǔyào kǎ zài lányá hé duōméitǐ mókuài.
lines.english: Currently the pass rate is 92%, target is 95%, mainly stuck on Bluetooth and multimedia modules.

lines.speaker: 安卓开发
lines.chinese: 多媒体的问题我在看，可能是codec配置不对，今天下午能出结论。
lines.pinyin: Duōméitǐ de wèntí wǒ zài kàn, kěnéng shì codec pèizhì bù duì, jīntiān xiàwǔ néng chū jiélùn.
lines.english: I'm looking into the multimedia issues, might be a codec configuration problem, I'll have a conclusion this afternoon.

lines.speaker: 项目经理
lines.chinese: 好，大家按计划推进，下午再同步一下。散会。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, dàjiā àn jìhuà tuījìn, xiàwǔ zài tóngbù yīxià. Sànhuì.
lines.english: Okay, everyone proceed as planned, let's sync up again this afternoon. Meeting adjourned.

key_vocabulary.context: test cases that did not pass
finding the root cause of an issue
to align on status or information

scenarios.description_en: A senior engineer is reviewing a junior developer's HAL integration code. They discuss error handling, logging, and CDD compliance.

lines.speaker: 高级开发
lines.chinese: 小王，我们来看一下你写的HAL集成代码。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng, wǒmen lái kàn yīxià nǐ xiě de HAL jíchéng dàimǎ.
lines.english: Xiao Wang, let's take a look at the HAL integration code you wrote.

lines.speaker: 初级开发
lines.chinese: 好的，我主要实现了设备初始化和数据读取功能。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ zhǔyào shíxiàn le shèbèi chūshǐhuà hé shùjù dúqǔ gōngnéng.
lines.english: Okay, I mainly implemented device initialization and data reading functions.

lines.speaker: 高级开发
lines.chinese: 我看到你在初始化函数里没有处理错误返回码。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào nǐ zài chūshǐhuà hánshù lǐ méiyǒu chǔlǐ cuòwù fǎnhuí mǎ.
lines.english: I noticed that you didn't handle error return codes in the initialization function.

lines.speaker: 初级开发
lines.chinese: 我以为只要返回成功就算完成了，没有考虑异常情况。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi zhǐyào fǎnhuí chénggōng jiù suàn wánchéng le, méiyǒu kǎolǜ yìcháng qíngkuàng.
lines.english: I thought it was done as long as it returned success, I didn't consider exceptional cases.

lines.speaker: 高级开发
lines.chinese: 错误处理很重要，尤其是硬件交互，必须检查每个API的返回值。
lines.pinyin: Cuòwù chǔlǐ hěn zhòngyào, yóuqí shì yìngjiàn jiāohù, bìxū jiǎnchá měi gè API de fǎnhuí zhí.
lines.english: Error handling is very important, especially for hardware interaction. You must check the return value of every API.

lines.speaker: 初级开发
lines.chinese: 明白了，我会加上错误检查并记录日志。
lines.pinyin: Míngbái le, wǒ huì jiā shàng cuòwù jiǎnchá bìng jìlù rìzhì.
lines.english: Got it, I'll add error checking and log the errors.

lines.speaker: 高级开发
lines.chinese: 还有日志级别要规范，调试信息用DEBUG，错误用ERROR。
lines.pinyin: Hái yǒu rìzhì jíbié yào guīfàn, diàoshì xìnxī yòng DEBUG, cuòwù yòng ERROR.
lines.english: Also, log levels should be standardized: use DEBUG for debugging info and ERROR for errors.

lines.speaker: 初级开发
lines.chinese: 好的，我会按照CDD规范修改日志格式。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ huì ànzhào CDD guīfàn xiūgǎi rìzhì géshì.
lines.english: Okay, I'll modify the log format according to CDD standards.

lines.speaker: 高级开发
lines.chinese: 另外，数据读取部分要加超时机制，防止死锁。
lines.pinyin: Lìngwài, shùjù dúqǔ bùfen yào jiā chāoshí jīzhì, fángzhǐ sǐsuǒ.
lines.english: Also, the data reading part should add a timeout mechanism to prevent deadlocks.

lines.speaker: 初级开发
lines.chinese: 谢谢指导，我改完后再请您审查一次。
lines.pinyin: Xièxiè zhǐdǎo, wǒ gǎi wán hòu zài qǐng nín shěnchá yī cì.
lines.english: Thank you for the guidance. After I make the changes, I'll ask you to review again.

key_vocabulary.context: combining hardware abstraction layer with system
setting up hardware or software at start
two processes waiting for each other

scenarios.description_en: The team is triaging bugs from the latest CTS run. They need to prioritize, assign owners, and determine if issues are blockers.

lines.speaker: 项目经理
lines.chinese: 大家早上好，今天我们来开bug分类会议，重点看一下CTS的测试结果。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā zǎoshang hǎo, jīntiān wǒmen lái kāi bug fēnlèi huìyì, zhòngdiǎn kàn yīxià CTS de cèshì jiéguǒ.
lines.english: Good morning everyone, today we'll have a bug triage meeting, focusing on the CTS test results.

lines.speaker: 测试主管
lines.chinese: 这次CTS跑下来，一共有15个失败用例，其中5个是新的，10个是之前就有的。
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì CTS pǎo xiàlái, yīgòng yǒu 15 gè shībài yònglì, qízhōng 5 gè shì xīn de, 10 gè shì zhīqián jiù yǒu de.
lines.english: In this CTS run, there are 15 failed test cases in total, 5 new and 10 pre-existing.

lines.speaker: 开发工程师
lines.chinese: 新失败的几个我看了，大部分是兼容性问题，有一个是内核崩溃，可能是blocker。
lines.pinyin: Xīn shībài de jǐ gè wǒ kàn le, dà bùfèn shì jiānróngxìng wèntí, yǒu yī gè shì nèihé bēngkuì, kěnéng shì blocker.
lines.english: I looked at the new failures, most are compatibility issues, one is a kernel crash, might be a blocker.

lines.speaker: 测试工程师
lines.chinese: 那个内核崩溃我复现了，在特定设备上必现，log里看到是内存越界。
lines.pinyin: Nàgè nèihé bēngkuì wǒ fùxiàn le, zài tèdìng shèbèi shàng bìxiàn, log lǐ kàndào shì nèicún yuèjiè.
lines.english: I reproduced that kernel crash, it's reproducible on specific devices, the log shows memory out-of-bounds.

lines.speaker: 项目经理
lines.chinese: 那这个blocker需要立即处理，优先级设为P0，开发能接手吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà zhège blocker xūyào lìjí chǔlǐ, yōuxiān jí shè wéi P0, kāifā néng jiēshǒu ma?
lines.english: Then this blocker needs immediate handling, set priority to P0, can development take it?

lines.speaker: 开发工程师
lines.chinese: 可以，我assign给我自己，今天开始查根因。
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ, wǒ assign gěi wǒ zìjǐ, jīntiān kāishǐ chá gēnyīn.
lines.english: Sure, I'll assign it to myself and start root cause analysis today.

lines.speaker: 测试主管
lines.chinese: 剩下的新失败，有几个是UI显示问题，严重性不高，可以放到下一个sprint。
lines.pinyin: Shèngxià de xīn shībài, yǒu jǐ gè shì UI xiǎnshì wèntí, yánzhòngxìng bù gāo, kěyǐ fàng dào xià yī gè sprint.
lines.english: For the remaining new failures, a few are UI display issues, not high severity, can be deferred to the next sprint.

lines.speaker: 测试工程师
lines.chinese: 那些旧的失败，有两个是环境问题，我已经重新跑了，通过了。
lines.pinyin: Nàxiē jiù de shībài, yǒu liǎng gè shì huánjìng wèntí, wǒ yǐjīng chóngxīn pǎo le, tōngguò le.
lines.english: For the old failures, two are environment issues, I reran them and they passed.

lines.speaker: 项目经理
lines.chinese: 好，那这两个可以关闭。其他旧的失败，有没有owner？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà zhè liǎng gè kěyǐ guānbì. Qítā jiù de shībài, yǒu méiyǒu owner?
lines.english: Good, those two can be closed. For other old failures, do they have owners?

lines.speaker: 开发工程师
lines.chinese: 有一个是多媒体相关的，之前assign给小王了，但他请假了，我来暂时接手。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yī gè shì duōméitǐ xiāngguān de, zhīqián assign gěi Xiǎo Wáng le, dàn tā qǐngjià le, wǒ lái zànshí jiēshǒu.
lines.english: One is multimedia-related, previously assigned to Xiao Wang, but he's on leave, I'll take over temporarily.

lines.speaker: 测试主管
lines.chinese: 那这个bug的优先级调成P2，等小王回来再确认。
lines.pinyin: Nà zhège bug de yōuxiān jí tiáo chéng P2, děng Xiǎo Wáng huílái zài quèrèn.
lines.english: Then set this bug's priority to P2, confirm when Xiao Wang returns.

lines.speaker: 项目经理
lines.chinese: 好，今天的分类就到这里，大家按assign的bug去处理，明天站会同步进展。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, jīntiān de fēnlèi jiù dào zhèlǐ, dàjiā àn assign de bug qù chǔlǐ, míngtiān zhànhuì tóngbù jìnzhǎn.
lines.english: OK, that's it for today's triage, everyone work on your assigned bugs, sync progress at tomorrow's standup.

key_vocabulary.context: used to prioritize and assign bugs
test cases that did not pass
level of urgency for a bug

scenarios.description_en: The team is planning the next 2-week sprint. They estimate story points for CDD test case automation and IVI feature development.

lines.speaker: 产品经理
lines.chinese: 好，我们开始冲刺计划会。这轮冲刺有两个重点：CDD测试用例自动化和IVI功能开发。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen kāishǐ chōngcì jìhuà huì. Zhè lún chōngcì yǒu liǎng gè zhòngdiǎn: CDD cèshì yònglì zìdònghuà hé IVI gōngnéng kāifā.
lines.english: Okay, let's start the sprint planning. This sprint has two focuses: CDD test case automation and IVI feature development.

lines.speaker: 技术主管
lines.chinese: 我先评估一下CDD自动化的工作量。大概有20个测试用例需要覆盖，每个用例估计2个故事点。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiān pínggū yīxià CDD zìdònghuà de gōngzuò liàng. Dàgài yǒu 20 gè cèshì yònglì xūyào fùgài, měi gè yònglì gūjì 2 gè gùshì diǎn.
lines.english: Let me first estimate the workload for CDD automation. There are about 20 test cases to cover, each estimated at 2 story points.

lines.speaker: 测试工程师
lines.chinese: 我觉得有些用例比较复杂，比如异常场景的处理，可能需要3个故事点。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒuxiē yònglì bǐjiào fùzá, bǐrú yìcháng chǎngjǐng de chǔlǐ, kěnéng xūyào 3 gè gùshì diǎn.
lines.english: I think some cases are more complex, like handling abnormal scenarios, which might need 3 story points.

lines.speaker: 技术主管
lines.chinese: 好，那我们把复杂用例标记一下，重新估算。另外，IVI功能开发你们怎么看？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒmen bǎ fùzá yònglì biāojì yīxià, chóngxīn gūsuàn. Lìngwài, IVI gōngnéng kāifā nǐmen zěnme kàn?
lines.english: Okay, let's mark the complex cases and re-estimate. Also, what do you think about the IVI feature development?

lines.speaker: 开发工程师
lines.chinese: IVI这边有三个主要模块：用户界面、数据同步和通知推送。每个模块大概5个故事点。
lines.pinyin: IVI zhè biān yǒu sān gè zhǔyào mókuài: yònghù jièmiàn, shùjù tóngbù hé tōngzhī tuīsòng. Měi gè mókuài dàgài 5 gè gùshì diǎn.
lines.english: For IVI, there are three main modules: UI, data sync, and notification push. Each module is about 5 story points.

lines.speaker: 产品经理
lines.chinese: 那总共就是15个点，加上CDD的40个点，一共55个故事点。我们冲刺容量是50点，超了5点。
lines.pinyin: Nà zǒnggòng jiùshì 15 gè diǎn, jiāshàng CDD de 40 gè diǎn, yīgòng 55 gè gùshì diǎn. Wǒmen chōngcì róngliàng shì 50 diǎn, chāo le 5 diǎn.
lines.english: So that's 15 points total, plus 40 for CDD, making 55 story points. Our sprint capacity is 50 points, so we're 5 points over.

lines.speaker: 技术主管
lines.chinese: 我们可以把CDD中优先级低的用例移到下一个冲刺，比如那些非核心功能的自动化。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ bǎ CDD zhōng yōuxiān jí dī de yònglì yí dào xià yī gè chōngcì, bǐrú nàxiē fēi héxīn gōngnéng de zìdònghuà.
lines.english: We can move low-priority CDD cases to the next sprint, like automation for non-core features.

lines.speaker: 测试工程师
lines.chinese: 同意，这样我们可以集中精力完成高优先级的自动化用例。
lines.pinyin: Tóngyì, zhèyàng wǒmen kěyǐ jízhōng jīnglì wánchéng gāo yōuxiān jí de zìdònghuà yònglì.
lines.english: Agreed, this way we can focus on completing high-priority automation cases.

lines.speaker: 产品经理
lines.chinese: 好，那调整后CDD是30个点，IVI是15个点，总共45点，在容量内。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà tiáozhěng hòu CDD shì 30 gè diǎn, IVI shì 15 gè diǎn, zǒnggòng 45 diǎn, zài róngliàng nèi.
lines.english: Okay, so after adjustment, CDD is 30 points, IVI is 15 points, total 45 points, within capacity.

lines.speaker: 开发工程师
lines.chinese: IVI的依赖项需要注意，数据同步模块需要后端API支持，后端团队能按时提供吗？
lines.pinyin: IVI de yīlài xiàng xūyào zhùyì, shùjù tóngbù mókuài xūyào hòuduān API zhīchí, hòuduān tuánduì néng ànshí tígōng ma?
lines.english: We need to watch the dependencies for IVI. The data sync module requires backend API support. Can the backend team deliver on time?

lines.speaker: 技术主管
lines.chinese: 我已经和后台团队确认过了，API会在冲刺第三天准备好，不影响我们的进度。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng hé hòutái tuánduì quèrèn guò le, API huì zài chōngcì dì sān tiān zhǔnbèi hǎo, bù yǐngxiǎng wǒmen de jìndù.
lines.english: I've confirmed with the backend team. The API will be ready by the third day of the sprint, so it won't affect our progress.

lines.speaker: 产品经理
lines.chinese: 很好，那我们就按这个计划执行。大家还有问题吗？没有的话，冲刺目标就确定了。
lines.pinyin: Hěn hǎo, nà wǒmen jiù àn zhège jìhuà zhíxíng. Dàjiā hái yǒu wèntí ma? Méiyǒu dehuà, chōngcì mùbiāo jiù quèdìng le.
lines.english: Great, let's proceed with this plan. Any questions? If not, the sprint goal is set.

key_vocabulary.context: used at the start of the meeting
used when deciding which tasks to move
used for IVI module needing backend API
used to check if workload fits

scenarios.description_en: Engineers are discussing whether their device meets a specific CDD requirement about audio latency. They refer to the CDD document and CTS test results.

lines.speaker: 系统架构师
lines.chinese: 我们来看一下CDD里关于音频延迟的要求。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen lái kàn yīxià CDD lǐ guānyú yīnpín yánchí de yāoqiú.
lines.english: Let's look at the CDD requirements for audio latency.

lines.speaker: 音频工程师
lines.chinese: 根据CDD文档，音频输出延迟必须小于50毫秒。
lines.pinyin: Gēnjù CDD wéndàng, yīnpín shūchū yánchí bìxū xiǎoyú 50 háomiǎo.
lines.english: According to the CDD document, audio output latency must be less than 50 milliseconds.

lines.speaker: 测试工程师
lines.chinese: 我们CTS测试的结果显示平均延迟是45毫秒，但有些场景下会超过50毫秒。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen CTS cèshì de jiéguǒ xiǎnshì píngjūn yánchí shì 45 háomiǎo, dàn yǒuxiē chǎngjǐng xià huì chāoguò 50 háomiǎo.
lines.english: Our CTS test results show an average latency of 45ms, but it exceeds 50ms in some scenarios.

lines.speaker: 系统架构师
lines.chinese: 哪些场景？是蓝牙耳机还是扬声器？
lines.pinyin: Nǎxiē chǎngjǐng? Shì lányá ěrjī háishì yángshēngqì?
lines.english: Which scenarios? Bluetooth headphones or speakers?

lines.speaker: 测试工程师
lines.chinese: 主要是蓝牙A2DP播放时，延迟会达到55毫秒。
lines.pinyin: Zhǔyào shì lányá A2DP bōfàng shí, yánchí huì dádào 55 háomiǎo.
lines.english: Mainly during Bluetooth A2DP playback, latency reaches 55ms.

lines.speaker: 音频工程师
lines.chinese: 那我们需要优化蓝牙音频路径，可能得调整缓冲区大小。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen xūyào yōuhuà lányá yīnpín lùjìng, kěnéng děi tiáozhěng huǎnchōng qū dàxiǎo.
lines.english: Then we need to optimize the Bluetooth audio path, maybe adjust the buffer size.

lines.speaker: 系统架构师
lines.chinese: 但调整缓冲区会影响稳定性，我们需要确认CDD是否允许例外。
lines.pinyin: Dàn tiáozhěng huǎnchōng qū huì yǐngxiǎng wěndìngxìng, wǒmen xūyào quèrèn CDD shìfǒu yǔnxǔ lìwài.
lines.english: But adjusting the buffer may affect stability; we need to confirm if CDD allows exceptions.

lines.speaker: 测试工程师
lines.chinese: CDD里有一条备注，说非音乐场景下延迟可以放宽到80毫秒。
lines.pinyin: CDD lǐ yǒu yī tiáo bèizhù, shuō fēi yīnyuè chǎngjǐng xià yánchí kěyǐ fàngkuān dào 80 háomiǎo.
lines.english: There's a note in CDD saying latency can be relaxed to 80ms in non-music scenarios.

lines.speaker: 音频工程师
lines.chinese: 那我们可以把蓝牙A2DP归类为语音场景，这样延迟要求就满足了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen kěyǐ bǎ lányá A2DP guīlèi wéi yǔyīn chǎngjǐng, zhèyàng yánchí yāoqiú jiù mǎnzú le ma?
lines.english: Then can we classify Bluetooth A2DP as a voice scenario, so the latency requirement is met?

lines.speaker: 系统架构师
lines.chinese: 这个归类需要和产品经理确认，但技术上可以先尝试优化缓冲区。
lines.pinyin: Zhège guīlèi xūyào hé chǎnpǐn jīnglǐ quèrèn, dàn jìshù shàng kěyǐ xiān chángshì yōuhuà huǎnchōng qū.
lines.english: This classification needs confirmation with the product manager, but technically we can try optimizing the buffer first.

scenarios.description_en: The test team is presenting weekly automation test results to the development team. They show pass rates, coverage metrics, and failed test analysis.

lines.speaker: 测试主管
lines.chinese: 这周的自动化测试结果出来了，整体通过率是92%。
lines.pinyin: Zhè zhōu de zìdònghuà cèshì jiéguǒ chūlái le, zhěngtǐ tōngguòlǜ shì 92%.
lines.english: This week's automation test results are out, with an overall pass rate of 92%.

lines.speaker: 自动化工程师
lines.chinese: 我们新增了50个测试用例，代码覆盖率从75%提升到了82%。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen xīnzēng le 50 gè cèshì yònglì, dàimǎ fùgàilǜ cóng 75% tíshēng dào le 82%.
lines.english: We added 50 new test cases, and code coverage increased from 75% to 82%.

lines.speaker: 开发工程师
lines.chinese: 那失败的8%主要是什么原因？有没有我们开发需要修复的bug？
lines.pinyin: Nà shībài de 8% zhǔyào shì shénme yuányīn? Yǒu méiyǒu wǒmen kāifā xūyào xiūfù de bug?
lines.english: What are the main reasons for the 8% failures? Are there any bugs we developers need to fix?

lines.speaker: 自动化工程师
lines.chinese: 大部分是环境问题，比如测试数据库连接超时。只有3个是真正的代码缺陷。
lines.pinyin: Dà bùfèn shì huánjìng wèntí, bǐrú cèshì shùjùkù liánjiē chāoshí. Zhǐyǒu 3 gè shì zhēnzhèng de dàimǎ quēxiàn.
lines.english: Most are environment issues, like test database connection timeouts. Only 3 are actual code defects.

lines.speaker: 测试主管
lines.chinese: 我已经把失败的测试用例和日志链接发到群里了，大家可以看一下。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ shībài de cèshì yònglì hé rìzhì liànjiē fā dào qún lǐ le, dàjiā kěyǐ kàn yīxià.
lines.english: I've already posted the failed test cases and log links in the group chat, everyone can take a look.

lines.speaker: 开发工程师
lines.chinese: 好的，我下午会排查那3个缺陷。另外，自动化测试的执行时间好像变长了？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ xiàwǔ huì páichá nà 3 gè quēxiàn. Lìngwài, zìdònghuà cèshì de zhíxíng shíjiān hǎoxiàng biàn cháng le?
lines.english: Okay, I'll investigate those 3 defects this afternoon. Also, the execution time of the automated tests seems longer?

lines.speaker: 自动化工程师
lines.chinese: 对，因为新增了用例，而且有些用例需要等待异步任务完成。我们正在优化。
lines.pinyin: Duì, yīnwèi xīnzēng le yònglì, érqiě yǒuxiē yònglì xūyào děngdài yìbù rènwù wánchéng. Wǒmen zhèngzài yōuhuà.
lines.english: Yes, because we added new cases, and some cases need to wait for async tasks to complete. We're optimizing.

lines.speaker: 测试主管
lines.chinese: 另外，我们计划下周把冒烟测试集成到CI/CD流水线中，这样每次提交代码都会自动运行。
lines.pinyin: Lìngwài, wǒmen jìhuà xià zhōu bǎ màoyān cèshì jíchéng dào CI/CD liúshuǐxiàn zhōng, zhèyàng měi cì tíjiāo dàimǎ dōu huì zìdòng yùnxíng.
lines.english: Also, we plan to integrate smoke tests into the CI/CD pipeline next week, so they'll run automatically on every code commit.

lines.speaker: 开发工程师
lines.chinese: 这个好，能尽早发现问题。不过要确保冒烟测试执行时间不超过5分钟。
lines.pinyin: Zhège hǎo, néng jǐnzǎo fāxiàn wèntí. Búguò yào quèbǎo màoyān cèshì zhíxíng shíjiān bù chāoguò 5 fēnzhōng.
lines.english: That's good, it can catch issues early. But make sure the smoke test execution time doesn't exceed 5 minutes.

lines.speaker: 测试主管
lines.chinese: 没问题，我们会控制用例数量。今天的评审就到这里，大家有什么问题随时沟通。
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí, wǒmen huì kòngzhì yònglì shùliàng. Jīntiān de píngshěn jiù dào zhèlǐ, dàjiā yǒu shénme wèntí suíshí gōutōng.
lines.english: No problem, we'll control the number of cases. That's all for today's review, feel free to communicate if you have any questions.

scenarios.description_en: A critical bug was found in the field that causes system crashes during OTA updates. The team is having an urgent call to coordinate the fix.

lines.speaker: 值班工程师
lines.chinese: 经理，线上发现一个严重bug，OTA升级会导致系统崩溃。
lines.pinyin: Jīnglǐ, xiànshàng fāxiàn yī gè yánzhòng bug, OTA shēngjí huì dǎozhì xìtǒng bēngkuì.
lines.english: Manager, a critical bug was found in production. The OTA update causes system crashes.

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.chinese: 立即拉群，开发、测试都进来，我们先评估影响范围。
lines.pinyin: Lìjí lā qún, kāifā, cèshì dōu jìnlái, wǒmen xiān pínggū yǐngxiǎng fànwéi.
lines.english: Create a group chat immediately, include dev and QA. Let's first assess the impact scope.

lines.speaker: 开发工程师
lines.chinese: 我看了日志，是OTA下载包校验时内存溢出导致的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kàn le rìzhì, shì OTA xiàzài bāo jiàoyàn shí nèicún yìchū dǎozhì de.
lines.english: I checked the logs. It's caused by a memory overflow during OTA package verification.

lines.speaker: 测试工程师
lines.chinese: 这个场景我们测试覆盖过，但可能并发量大的时候才会触发。
lines.pinyin: Zhège chǎngjǐng wǒmen cèshì fùgài guò, dàn kěnéng bìngfā liàng dà de shíhou cái huì chùfā.
lines.english: We covered this scenario in testing, but it might only trigger under high concurrency.

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.chinese: 先回滚版本，暂停OTA推送，避免影响更多用户。
lines.pinyin: Xiān huígǔn bǎnběn, zàntíng OTA tuīsòng, bìmiǎn yǐngxiǎng gèng duō yònghù.
lines.english: Roll back the version first and pause OTA push to avoid affecting more users.

lines.speaker: 值班工程师
lines.chinese: 收到，我已经在操作回滚，预计10分钟完成。
lines.pinyin: Shōudào, wǒ yǐjīng zài cāozuò huígǔn, yùjì 10 fēnzhōng wánchéng.
lines.english: Got it. I'm already rolling back, estimated completion in 10 minutes.

lines.speaker: 开发工程师
lines.chinese: 我这边定位到问题了，需要修改内存分配逻辑，大概2小时能出hotfix。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhè biān dìngwèi dào wèntí le, xūyào xiūgǎi nèicún fēnpèi luóji, dàgài 2 xiǎoshí néng chū hotfix.
lines.english: I've located the issue. I need to fix the memory allocation logic; a hotfix should be ready in about 2 hours.

lines.speaker: 测试工程师
lines.chinese: hotfix出来后我先做冒烟测试，然后全量回归。
lines.pinyin: Hotfix chūlái hòu wǒ xiān zuò màoyān cèshì, ránhòu quánliàng huíguī.
lines.english: After the hotfix is out, I'll run a smoke test first, then full regression.

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.chinese: 好，大家辛苦，这次事故要写复盘报告，分析根因和改进措施。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, dàjiā xīnkǔ, zhè cì shìgù yào xiě fùpán bàogào, fēnxī gēnyīn hé gǎijìn cuòshī.
lines.english: Okay, everyone, good work. We need to write a postmortem report for this incident, analyzing root cause and improvement measures.

lines.speaker: 值班工程师
lines.chinese: 回滚完成，线上已恢复，我继续监控一段时间。
lines.pinyin: Huígǔn wánchéng, xiànshàng yǐ huīfù, wǒ jìxù jiānkòng yī duàn shíjiān.
lines.english: Rollback complete, production is restored. I'll continue monitoring for a while.

key_vocabulary.context: used to refer to the live system

scenarios.description_en: The team is reviewing a new architecture for the IVI middleware layer. They discuss HAL design, API contracts, and performance requirements.

lines.speaker: 系统架构师
lines.chinese: 今天我们评审IVI中间层的架构设计，先从HAL层开始。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒmen píngshěn IVI zhōngjiān céng de jiàgòu shèjì, xiān cóng HAL céng kāishǐ.
lines.english: Today we review the IVI middleware layer architecture design, starting with the HAL layer.

lines.speaker: HAL开发
lines.chinese: HAL层我们采用抽象接口设计，每个硬件模块对应一个HAL接口。
lines.pinyin: HAL céng wǒmen cǎiyòng chōuxiàng jiēkǒu shèjì, měi gè yìngjiàn mókuài duìyìng yī gè HAL jiēkǒu.
lines.english: For the HAL layer, we adopt an abstract interface design, each hardware module corresponds to one HAL interface.

lines.speaker: 框架工程师
lines.chinese: API契约需要明确参数和返回值类型，确保跨平台兼容。
lines.pinyin: API qìyuē xūyào míngquè cānshù hé fǎnhuí zhí lèixíng, quèbǎo kuà píngtái jiānróng.
lines.english: API contracts need to specify parameter and return value types to ensure cross-platform compatibility.

lines.speaker: 系统架构师
lines.chinese: 性能需求方面，HAL层调用延迟必须控制在5毫秒以内。
lines.pinyin: Xìngnéng xūqiú fāngmiàn, HAL céng diàoyòng yánchí bìxū kòngzhì zài 5 háomiǎo yǐnèi.
lines.english: Regarding performance requirements, HAL layer call latency must be controlled within 5 milliseconds.

lines.speaker: 测试架构师
lines.chinese: 我们需要设计压力测试场景，模拟高并发访问HAL接口。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào shèjì yālì cèshì chǎngjǐng, mónǐ gāo bìngfā fǎngwèn HAL jiēkǒu.
lines.english: We need to design stress test scenarios to simulate high-concurrency access to HAL interfaces.

lines.speaker: HAL开发
lines.chinese: 接口定义中，我们使用了回调机制来处理异步事件。
lines.pinyin: Jiēkǒu dìngyì zhōng, wǒmen shǐyòng le huídiào jīzhì lái chǔlǐ yìbù shìjiàn.
lines.english: In the interface definition, we use a callback mechanism to handle asynchronous events.

lines.speaker: 框架工程师
lines.chinese: 中间层需要提供统一的资源管理，避免内存泄漏。
lines.pinyin: Zhōngjiān céng xūyào tígōng tǒngyī de zīyuán guǎnlǐ, bìmiǎn nèicún xièlòu.
lines.english: The middleware layer needs to provide unified resource management to avoid memory leaks.

lines.speaker: 测试架构师
lines.chinese: 我会编写自动化测试用例，覆盖所有HAL接口的边界条件。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ huì biānxiě zìdòng huà cèshì yònglì, fùgài suǒyǒu HAL jiēkǒu de biānjiè tiáojiàn.
lines.english: I will write automated test cases covering all boundary conditions of HAL interfaces.

lines.speaker: 系统架构师
lines.chinese: 性能基准测试要在原型阶段完成，确保延迟达标。
lines.pinyin: Xìngnéng jīzhǔn cèshì yào zài yuánxíng jiēduàn wánchéng, quèbǎo yánchí dábiāo.
lines.english: Performance benchmark tests should be completed in the prototype phase to ensure latency meets targets.

lines.speaker: HAL开发
lines.chinese: 我们计划使用D-Bus作为进程间通信机制，但担心性能开销。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen jìhuà shǐyòng D-Bus zuòwéi jìnchéng jiān tōngxìn jīzhì, dàn dānxīn xìngnéng kāixiāo.
lines.english: We plan to use D-Bus as the inter-process communication mechanism, but we are concerned about performance overhead.

lines.speaker: 框架工程师
lines.chinese: 可以考虑共享内存替代D-Bus，减少数据拷贝次数。
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ kǎolǜ gòngxiǎng nèicún tìdài D-Bus, jiǎnshǎo shùjù kǎobèi cìshù.
lines.english: We can consider shared memory instead of D-Bus to reduce data copy times.

lines.speaker: 系统架构师
lines.chinese: 好，那我们下周再评审更新后的设计方案。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒmen xià zhōu zài píngshěn gēngxīn hòu de shèjì fāng'àn.
lines.english: Okay, then we will review the updated design next week.

key_vocabulary.context: used in the context of system design review
specification of API parameters and types
